new.statement: Character-art thumbnails go with higher Up-and-Coming positions than gameplay screenshots among games of the same age
Games updated more recently rank higher on Up-and-Coming among games of the same age
Young games with a page video climb Top Trending more slowly than those without
Games with more favorites per thousand visits earn a higher Top Earning position for their CCU
A high favorite rate per visit goes with lower Most Popular positions (big evergreens convert fewer visits into favorites)
Short-session party formats (1v1 table duels, would-you-rather towers, hide-and-seek variants) are a rotating wave that re-surfaces old games on Top Trending without lifting them onto Top Earning
new.rationale: Of 34 new Top Trending entries today, many are party/would-you-rather games, several 1-2 years old (Cartoons Tower 2487d, Mingle Carousel 687d, Shrink Hide & Seek 522d) and none of those are on Top Earning. Confirm if they fall off within a week and never enter Top Earning.

qualitative_updates.note: Entry counts grew to tt->mp 10 (median 2d), uc->tt 9 (1d), uc->te 6 (1d); the order still holds but te->tt 7 and te->uc 6 show Top Earning is often reached first too, so the sequence is not strict.
